tweet.text: METR received access to an earlier checkpoint of OpenAI’s GPT-4.5, 7 days before release. We ran quick experiments to measure the model’s performance. As with OAI’s results, GPT-4.5 performs above GPT 4o but below o1 or Claude 3.5 Sonnet, with a time horizon score of ~30 minutes.
